scope: Implement a bounded, exact, causal bootstrap/update/snapshot operator for the four strict-R3 own-history residual/surprise fields without changing the live configuration or the existing long-memory fallback list.

evidence.batch_vs_features_residual: exact prior-only 96-row median/MAD parity for all four fields
evidence.opt_in_raw_provider: disabled path retains ordinary batch outputs; enabled one-row append matches full-batch raw residuals
evidence.causal_transform_container: enabled residual raw outputs enter the existing per-feature CausalTransformStateContainer before transformation; the resumed latest row matches full-batch causal transform
evidence.irregular_timestamp_gap: passed; gaps are not synthesized and preserve integer-row rolling semantics
evidence.missingness: passed; missing parents remain unavailable and are never zero-filled

validation.decision: The operator is a bounded exact primitive and opt-in raw provider, wired before the existing causal transform but disabled by every live configuration. It does not remove any fallback field. Enabling it in the strict-R3 incremental producer requires the complete 120-field plus downstream score/admission/policy parity gates before any live binding.

agent_plan.delegation_note: Bounded implementation requested by the lead; no further delegation used.
